source: In the S bus, in the rush hour. A chap of about 26, felt hat with a cord instead of a ribbon, neck too long, as if someone’s been having a tug-of-war with it. People getting off. The chap in question gets annoyed with one of the men standing next to him. He accuses him of jostling him every time anyone goes past. A snivelling tone which is meant to be aggressive. When he sees a vacant seat he throws himself on to it. Two hours later, I meet him in the Cour de Rome, in front of the gare Saint-Lazare. He’s with a friend who’s saying: "You ought to get an extra button put on your overcoat." He shows him where (at the lapels) and why.

gens.text: Amidst the rush, through the bustling aisle, flanked by the conveyor's hum, beneath the scanner's gaze, within the shadow of the divider, lies the choreographed dance of commerce. Each shopper, numbered among the myriad, with their carts laden under the watchful eye of the cashier, whose hands move with practiced ease, guiding each item across the gleaming belt, beneath the scanner’s beam, amidst the beep of transactions sealed, the total announced in crisp tones, loyalty points whispered into the card slot's ear, where another waits impatiently, pressing forward, a murmur of impatience rising as personal space shrinks to a whisper, the cashier, unflappable, continues the ritual, each transaction a note in the symphony of sales, until the last item slips from the belt, into the waiting arms of the shopper, who departs with a swipe of receipted proof, the next in line already stepping forward, the process seamless, mechanical, a rhythm that never falters, even as the crowd presses closer, the cashier’s smile unwavering beneath the scanner’s steady light.

Amidst through the bustling conveyor, each item slid under the scanning gaze of the cashier, alongside the divider bar where groceries nestled close to avoid the squeezing shopper lurking behind.

The cashier, amidst the constant beeping of items and the swish of the loyalty card slot, diligently tallied the total, eyes fixed on the screen displaying numeric figures, while the impatient figure behind murmured softly but persistently, nudging closer against the barrier, seeking to merge their own cart into this stream; should they manage to squeeze in, the cashier would need to recalibrate the rhythm of the routine, ensuring every item was accounted for and every barcode had been scanned without fail.

Groceries piled up, awaiting the next stage.

The conveyor, laden with goods stretching across its surface, paused momentarily as if questioning the pace of the cashier's hands, who, with practiced ease, navigated the rhythm between the scanning device and the card reader, orchestrating this dance with efficiency, until the moment where an impatient prompt from the back pushed subtly yet firmly towards a quicker conclusion.

She, amidst the jostling, maintained focus, her voice clear despite the pressure, announcing the total as another shopper's presence hinted at further impatience, threatening to disrupt the flow of the checkout process.

An orderly yet tense scene unfolded.

The shopper's cart, filled to capacity, stretched across the conveyor belt, testing its limits, while another stood poised at the edge of the divider, their own groceries ready to challenge the space.

The cashier managed these interruptions smoothly, the card reader humming in response to each swipe, the totals displayed with a finality that belied the tension behind.

The queue moved forward, albeit with slight friction, as the loyal shoppers' cards were processed swiftly, the cashier's voice clear and concise amidst the murmurs of those waiting.

Another transaction concluded with the printing of a receipt, signaling the end of one interaction and the beginning of the next in this cycle of retail precision.

Through the throngs, amidst the bustling crowd, the conveyor belt stretched out like a serpentine queue, winding past the barcode scanner, the card reader nestled nearby, the cashier diligently scanning each item with practiced ease, while bags filled to brim at the side, a shopper impatiently pressing from behind, her cart nearly brushing against the divider bar, the beeps echoing the tally of groceries stacked, the total announced over the ambient hum, loyalty-card prompts flashing intermittently, another customer jostling, barely within reach, the receipt printed, the transaction sealed.

Upon the gleaming conveyor, amidst flurried transactions, shoppers jostle near the divider where barcodes hiss and flutter.

Every twentieth cart, laden with groaning goods, meets the cashier’s brisk scan, whose beep echoes across aisles; meanwhile, a hurried clerk bags items with nimble speed, behind the register where receipts unspool, before the impatient crowd presses closer, some even crowding from behind, their impatience evident as they hover anxiously, almost leaning, ready to rush forward the moment space opens up again, while others whisper nervously about the crush, barely maintaining calm.

The cashier swipes each card efficiently.

Each scanned item whispers its price, adding digits rapidly under the glare of harsh lights, beneath which the shopper stands, fidgeting slightly; beside them, bags accumulate steadily, each filled with groceries neatly arranged, their contents visible through clear plastic, revealing the daily essentials purchased.

The shopper's cart, filled to the brim, was wheeled swiftly to the checkout lane, where it paused momentarily, waiting for its turn under the watchful eye of the barcode scanner.

I handed over my loyalty card quickly, my hands shaking slightly, and watched nervously as the cashier tapped away, before announcing the total amount due in a voice tinged with urgency.

She leaned forward, reaching out for her wallet, her fingers trembling.

Behind me, another shopper pressed close, murmuring impatiently, their voice laced with irritation as they waited for their turn in the long line, eager to complete their transaction as swiftly as possible.

We all stood there, caught in the rhythmic dance of daily commerce, our movements governed by the beeps and clicks of machines, each action leading seamlessly to the next, like an orchestrated ballet played out in the narrow confines of the checkout line.

My card slipped silently through the slot, confirming the payment, a brief moment of relief washing over me as the transaction concluded.

Amongst the bustling queues, through the vibrant aisle's heart, the conveyor belt hummed, swiftly swallowing cartons beneath the scanner’s vigilant eye, while the card reader whispered secrets to the bagging zone’s attentive ears.

The shoppers’ endless stream, on that frenetic Saturday morn, around six hundred and thirty-five, were checking out, their carts laden with weekly necessities, their dividers clinking rhythmically, under the cashier’s practiced gaze, their voices echoing amidst the beeping sounds, as the loyalty cards flashed momentarily bright, when the totals were called aloud, their purchases tallied just as the murmurs of a newcomer nudged closer behind them, impatiently insisting on their right to join, their impatience palpable as they leaned forward into the narrow aisle.

The shopper scanned his items quietly.

Their carts, each one encased in the protective shield of the divider, were processed, amidst the rhythmic pinging, where the cashier worked with practiced precision, scanning each item with deft hands, as the total was announced, the plastic bags filled methodically, as the receipt spurted forth from its slot, and the shopper stepped back, giving way to the next in line, their loyalty cards swiped effortlessly, as the conveyor belt whirred on relentlessly.

The shopper behind felt crowded, their frustration mounting, as they jockeyed for space, the queue thickening, their eyes darting from the divider to the cashier, whose voice remained steady amidst the chaos, as they counted down the final items, the beep of the card reader punctuating the quietude, their loyalty cards flashing once more, as they exchanged a terse nod before stepping away, their patience frayed yet unbroken.

The orderly procession of items was disrupted briefly, by the sudden press of bodies, where the queue’s calm facade was momentarily shattered, as shoppers navigated the narrow confines, their carts jostling gently against the conveyor’s relentless pace, the cashier maintaining a serene demeanor throughout, as they completed the transaction with practiced ease, the divider bars acting as silent mediators between strangers.

The shopper stepped aside promptly, allowing the queue to flow smoothly, as another took their place, the conveyor belt continuing its rhythmic motion, where the scanner hummed faithfully, tallying each item meticulously, and the receipt was handed over with a polite nod, their loyalty cards registered swiftly, before they moved on, making room for the next in line.

Amidst the flurry of activity, amidst the beeps and whispers, six hundred and thirty-six items passed through, their totals announced with precision, as the cashier’s hands moved with practiced efficiency, the loyalty cards flashing intermittently, as the queue flowed seamlessly forward, where the shopper behind lingered momentarily, before stepping up, their presence barely noted.

The shopper felt their presence keenly, as the cashier’s hands moved steadily, scanning items with practiced ease, the queue moving forward with measured grace, as the total was announced, the loyalty cards swiped, the receipt printed, and the shopper stepped aside, making room for the next, their experience seamless despite the underlying tension.

The shopper nodded curtly, handing over the last few items, their voice a mere whisper in the din, as the cashier’s smile widened momentarily, the loyalty card prompt answered swiftly, before they moved aside, their exit marked by a final beep from the register, as the next stepped into the fray, the queue continuing unabated.

Among the bustling queues, beneath the flickering neon, sprawled the endless loop of conveyor belts winding around the divider bars, where shoppers queued with carts heavy with purchases.

The cashier, behind gleaming registers and amidst the constant beep, scanned each item swiftly, totaling a dizzying array of goods; under the watchful eye of surveillance cameras, amidst the buzz of fluorescent lights, she worked diligently, her actions mirrored by the rhythm of her colleague's fingers navigating through loyalty-card databases.

The shopper hesitated.

Behind the glass of the register, where the bagging area hummed with activity, stood silent witness to the tension that built when another customer edged closer, their breath hot against the back of the first, crowding the aisle narrow, reducing space to mere inches.

She glanced, bewildered, at the display flashing numbers, her gaze seeking the cashier’s guidance.

The card reader glowed, awaiting payment for items listed, whose total soared unexpectedly high, prompting a sigh and a fumble through pockets for coins, while behind, whispers murmured about impatience.

Glancing over shoulder, she saw agitation rise, yet remained rooted before the scanner, whose relentless hum signaled each scanned item.

In line, time stretched endlessly, marked only by the slow progress of the conveyor belt, which carried bags across, past the point where hands grasped, holding them steady under the glare of light.

She was the center, between the flow of goods and the steady stream of customers, a focal point where patience thinned as totals flashed, receipts printed, and another shopper moved up.

She nodded, handing over cash, her eyes following the transaction, her relief palpable as the card reader acknowledged the payment, the queue shifting subtly forward.

Amidst the throng, beneath the glow of fluorescents, the brisk conveyance wound through the maze of carts and shoppers, past the gleaming scanner and the card reader’s hum. Amidst the press, the divider bar stood vigilant, as patrons jockeyed for space; thrice had the line snaked through aisles where the cashier swiftly processed transactions, her movements synchronized with the rhythmic beeping, as the belt bore parcels toward their fate under the scanner’s glare, until the total chimed, prompting loyalty-card queries and the occasional clash of elbows—another shopper, eager, encroached from behind, nudged closer, impatient, pressing against the queue, murmuring frustrations, until, amidst the hubbub, the cashier’s tone grew firm, signaling the end of grace. The shopper pushed, her cart nearly tipping, as the cashier scanned the last item, the receipt spooling out like a ribbon of parting, the transaction complete.

Amidst the bustling hub of transactions, behind the gleaming cashier's divider, under the swift conveyor belt's hum, amidst the rhythmic tap of the barcode scanner, within the narrow confines between the bustling shopper and the cashier, beneath the incessant clink of coins and the crisp rustle of notes, amidst the gentle urging of a hurried bagger, amidst the subtle tension of another customer's impatient elbow, between the whispered murmurs of loyalty card incentives and the brisk announcements of totals, amid the fleeting exchanges of receipts and polite farewells, through the steady gaze of the card reader's blinking light, there arose a fleeting skirmish over scarce spatial claims. The cashier's eyes flickered between the laden cart and the divider bar, scanning swiftly the arrayed items, as the shopper's fingers hesitated briefly on the conveyor belt, their eyes darting between the items and the receipt. The shopper beside, pressed slightly forward, nearly touching the divider, murmured softly of time lost, urging subtly with each beep of the scanner. Through each transaction's familiar rhythm, the tension ebbed and flowed until the momentary standoff was resolved with the final beep of completion, marking the end of the brief but palpable friction.

Amidst the clatter of the checkout lane, beneath the hum of the fluorescent lights, lay the brisk conveyance where scanned items slid like whispers. The throng surged forward, with a lone shopper jostling the queue’s edge, his cart wedged against a divider, a cashier's gaze flickering across the screen. Through the din of pings and dings, amidst the rustle of plastic bags, the scanner beeped with each new item, tallying sums, prompting loyalty cards, as another patron pushed from behind. Amid such hustle, the shopper placed their hand on the card reader, feeling eyes on their every move; meanwhile, another muttered, "Just hurry," as they too eyed the exit, hoping for a quick escape. In such a flurry, the cashier’s voice barely broke through the noise, declaring the final total, while the bagging area buzzed with activity. As the receipt printed, the shopper slipped it into a pocket, turning to leave with a hasty thank you, already lost in thoughts of the next aisle to traverse.

Amidst the swirl of plastic, through the mesh of the conveyor, beneath the scanner’s hum, shoppers lined up, their carts wedged between divider bars, receipts curling from the printer, the card reader awaiting swipes and taps, loyalty points promised under the glare of fluorescent light.

The line, stretching to ten, moved sluggishly, each shopper impatient under the pressure of time, while the cashier scanned codes, bags clinked on the counter, groceries sorted and stacked, a shopper pressing close behind, murmuring about space, the cashier acknowledged, nodding briskly as totals beeped, loyalty cards flashed once more.

Time squeezed past, each moment ticking as the conveyor rolled onwards.

The shopper’s cart was seized by the cashier’s practiced hands, the transaction swift but for the occasional pause when numbers flickered on the screen, the card reader whirred, a shopper lingered with a plea, the cashier nodded, understanding, yet pressed onward, totals announced, the queue shifting, the next step awaited.

Another shopper, caught within the throng, was swept along, bound by the rhythm of the queue, their cart nudged gently forward, the cashier’s voice a steady guide through the maze of products and prices, loyalty cards swiped again.

The shopper, lost in the shuffle, felt eyes upon them, the cashier’s hands deft, their motions a dance of routine, bags filled swiftly, totals whispered by the machine, loyalty cards held aloft in eager hands.

Swiftly, the line advanced, shoppers glided forward, each motion timed, the cashier’s voice clear over the din, totals chimed, bags zipped closed, the next in line stepped up, their cart poised, ready to enter the fray.

The clock’s hand crept onward, each minute marked by the rhythm of the line, the cashier’s face set in the task, each shopper a blur passing, totals declared, bags handed off, the conveyor a relentless guide.

Each shopper, caught in the current, drifted with the tide, the cashier’s gestures smooth, the transactions flowing, each loyalty card swiped with practiced ease, totals ringing out like echoes in the hall.

The line surged, each shopper propelled forward, totals announced, bags grasped, the cycle complete, shoppers dispersed into the aisles, the cashier readied for the next turn.
